name: STIR Fat Suppression TI (Vendor-Specific)
description: DWI should use STIR fat suppression. MY-RADS specifies TI=180ms for Siemens/Philips and TI=170ms for GE. (From the MY-RADS Myeloma Whole-Body MRI Guidelines schema.)
implementation:
inversion_time = value["InversionTime"].dropna()
if len(inversion_time) == 0:
    raise ValidationWarning("InversionTime not found. STIR fat suppression is required.")
else:
    ti = inversion_time.iloc[0]
    manufacturer = value["Manufacturer"].iloc[0].upper() if "Manufacturer" in value.columns else ""
    
    # Vendor-specific TI targets from Table E1
    if "GE" in manufacturer or "GENERAL ELECTRIC" in manufacturer:
        target_ti = 170
        tolerance = 5
    elif "SIEMENS" in manufacturer:
        target_ti = 180
        tolerance = 5
    elif "PHILIPS" in manufacturer:
        target_ti = 180
        tolerance = 5
    else:
        # Unknown vendor - accept 170-180 range
        target_ti = 175
        tolerance = 10
    
    # Graded severity: far outside the fat-null regime the STIR contrast
    # is fundamentally wrong (error); moderately off is suboptimal fat
    # suppression (warning).
    if abs(ti - target_ti) > 50:
        raise ValidationError(f"STIR InversionTime should be ~{target_ti} ms for this vendor. Found {ti} ms.")
    elif abs(ti - target_ti) > tolerance:
        raise ValidationWarning(f"STIR InversionTime should be ~{target_ti} ms for this vendor. Found {ti} ms.")
